sequential.name: Sequential Consultation
sequential.description: Execute executives in order of priority, passing results forward
sequential.best_for: When you need each executive to build upon previous insights

parallel.name: Parallel Consultation
parallel.description: Execute all executives simultaneously and combine results
parallel.best_for: When you need multiple viewpoints on the same issue

conditional.name: Smart Routing
conditional.description: Route queries to the most appropriate executive based on content
conditional.best_for: When the query clearly falls into one domain
